description: This file defines the WorkflowTypeInterface, an interface for workflow type plugins in Drupal, including methods for managing workflow states and transitions.

methods.name: label
methods.description: Returns the label for the workflow type.

methods.name: workflowHasData
methods.description: Checks if the workflow has data associated with it.

methods.name: workflowStateHasData
methods.description: Checks if a specific workflow state has data.

methods.name: getInitialState
methods.description: Retrieves the initial state of the workflow.

methods.name: getRequiredStates
methods.description: Returns the required states for the workflow type.

methods.name: onDependencyRemoval
methods.description: Handles the removal of dependencies.

methods.name: addState
methods.description: Adds a new state to the workflow.

methods.name: hasState
methods.description: Checks if a state exists in the workflow.

methods.name: getStates
methods.description: Retrieves states by IDs.

methods.name: getState
methods.description: Retrieves a specific state by ID.

methods.name: setStateLabel
methods.description: Sets the label for a state.

methods.name: setStateWeight
methods.description: Sets the weight for a state.

methods.name: deleteState
methods.description: Deletes a state from the workflow.

methods.name: addTransition
methods.description: Adds a transition between states.

methods.name: getTransition
methods.description: Retrieves a transition by ID.

methods.name: hasTransition
methods.description: Checks if a transition exists.

methods.name: getTransitions
methods.description: Retrieves multiple transitions by IDs.

methods.name: getTransitionsForState
methods.description: Gets transitions for a specific state and direction.

methods.name: getTransitionFromStateToState
methods.description: Gets a transition between two states.

methods.name: hasTransitionFromStateToState
methods.description: Checks if a transition exists between two states.

methods.name: setTransitionLabel
methods.description: Sets the label for a transition.

methods.name: setTransitionWeight
methods.description: Sets the weight for a transition.

methods.name: setTransitionFromStates
methods.description: Sets the from states for a transition.

methods.name: deleteTransition
methods.description: Deletes a transition.
